title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Describe the free motion of simple noncircular bodies through a stationary particle medium. For a rod and for centrally symmetric bodies initially rotating without translation, determine whether the total turns are finite and, if infinite, whether angular velocity tends to zero and with what asymptotic law.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200011 (AMR-051-0011). CC BY 4.0.

M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Alexander Plakhov, Problem 2 and footnote 4, pp. 8--9.
